How to follow up on a quote without sounding pushy (AI prompt)

You sent the quote. Then nothing. Quiet often means busy, not no, and a short, useful nudge makes it easy to say yes.

Copy this:

"I sent a quote for [JOB] to [CLIENT] on [DATE] and heard nothing. Write a follow-up under 60 words: one useful detail they may have missed, one easy yes/no question, no guilt-tripping. Useful detail: [E.G. A DEADLINE]."

The useful detail is the trick. A real ordering deadline, a free slot next week, a material that's back in stock. Give AI the true detail, don't let it invent one.

And set the reminder the moment you send the quote, not when you remember.

Send this to someone who still waits for clients to call back. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
